name: Kuranaga Kozue
source:
Representative of Haruka's class, a position of important functions and rights, Kozue has a strong sense of responsibility. Very diligent, she take care of all the work of a class rep and through her shy appearance she seems to fantasize about Haruka due to her crush towards him. Often nicknamed by 'iinchou'. (class rep)

[Edited from [url=http://yosuganosora.wikia.com/wiki/Kozue_Kuranaga]Yosuga no Sora Wikia[/url]]
